name: Site hierarchy, designs and zones
summary: Arranging project locations, attaching BIM models and 2D sheets, and defining zones within a structure.

nfr.statement: Largest hierarchy (structures, depth, designs per structure, zones per structure) that must stay usable.
nfr.open_question: What are today's largest projects by structures, designs and zones, and what depth must be supported (DEC-022)?

requirements.title: The site hierarchy is flexible
requirements.statement: Project locations nest freely. The hierarchy doesn't have to follow fixed site, building, floor and area levels. Allowed depth and relationships are open (DEC-022).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger
Track3D "Single Source of Truth" docs, generated from code

acceptance_criteria.when: A user adds a floor under it, an area under the floor, and a room under the area
acceptance_criteria.then: All four levels are saved and shown in that order

requirements.title: Zones must not overlap
requirements.statement: Zones may not overlap. Which zones are compared, how shared edges are treated, and whether overlap is blocked or flagged are open (DEC-022).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

open_checks: Verify the create, edit, import, clone, alignment and high-ceiling paths; none is shown to enforce non-overlap
Zone coverage uses system-space polygons first, then planar ones, and doesn't check overlap; unsupported shapes fail

acceptance_criteria.given: A zone exists on a floor
acceptance_criteria.when: A user draws a new zone that overlaps it within the same comparison scope

requirements.title: Customers see only active, non-internal designs
requirements.statement: Design counts, the structure status chip and the "has progress" flag use the project's active designs. For customers this excludes designs marked internal; support users see those too.

acceptance_criteria.given: A structure with two active designs, one marked internal
acceptance_criteria.when: A customer and a support user view it
acceptance_criteria.then: The customer sees a design count of 1, and the support user sees 2
